name: Fujigasaki Miho
source:
Her father was a cruise ship captain and her mother was an oceanographer.
Her mother died of illness several years ago, and since then she has lived with her father.

Although she hasn't decided on her future, she wants to work in a job related to the sea.

As part of that, she got a diving license. She's not very good at sports, but she is good at swimming.

Normally, she is a calm and reserved type, but when she goes out to sea, she gets a little excited.
